propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall hierarchy that fetch_snapshot's re-raise clauses check

fetch_snapshot's three enrichment fail-open handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) catch the stall with broad except Exception instead of the targeted except BackendPaginationStallError, swallowing the error and writing a degraded snapshot
A stalled Cloud pagination cursor produces a silently degraded snapshot instead of propagating the error and aborting the pass

Changing RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError allows the three fetcher re-raise clauses to match and propagate the stall, while preserving RuntimeError in the MRO for backward compatibility
The fix is confirmed by runtime testing with a token-repeating Cloud stub injected through the real fetch_snapshot, showing the stall now propagates instead of being swallowed
